title: SARA: good agents in, bad agents pay
instructions: Voice: a confident, warm product-launch narrator. Pace: brisk and energetic but clear, like a polished startup demo video. Short natural pauses at full stops. Slight emphasis on the numbers and on the product name SARA.

scenes.vo: One AI bot hit a single website 39,000 times in one minute. That's 650 requests every second.
scenes.caption: One AI bot hit a single website *39,000 times* in one minute. / That's *650 requests* every second.

visual.source: Source: Fastly, reported by The Register, August 2025

scenes.vo: AI agents are now your website's busiest visitors. Most are good. Some are not.
scenes.caption: AI agents are now your website's *busiest visitors.* / Most are *good.* Some are *not.*

items.text: Research agent: reads and cites you

scenes.vo: Bad agents ignore your rules. Sites list them in robots.txt, the web's standard rule file, but nothing enforces it.
scenes.caption: Bad agents *ignore your rules.* Sites list them in robots.txt, the web's standard rule file, / but *nothing enforces it.*

scenes.vo: They flood your servers. Wikimedia's bandwidth for media jumped 50 percent. Read the Docs paid over 5,000 dollars for one crawler's traffic.
scenes.caption: They *flood your servers.* Wikimedia's bandwidth for media jumped *50 percent.* / Read the Docs paid over *5,000 dollars* for one crawler's traffic.

visual.title: What bad agents cost real websites
visual.note: Sources: Fastly (Aug 2025), Wikimedia Foundation (Apr 2025), Read the Docs (Jul 2024)

scenes.vo: And here's the real problem. To your website, a good agent and a bad agent look exactly the same.
scenes.caption: And here's the *real problem.* / To your website, a good agent and a bad agent look *exactly the same.*

scenes.vo: So sites block them all, and lose the good ones too: the search traffic, the shoppers, the sales.
scenes.caption: So sites *block them all,* and lose the *good ones too:* / the search traffic, the shoppers, the sales.

scenes.vo: What if every agent had to prove it would behave, with its own money on the line?
scenes.caption: What if every agent had to *prove it would behave,* / with its *own money* on the line?

visual.title: Make every agent put <mark>money on the line</mark>. Behave, get it back. Break the rules, lose it.

scenes.vo: That's SARA: Safe And Responsible Agents. A gateway in front of your website, backed by PayPal.
scenes.caption: That's *SARA:* Safe And Responsible Agents. / A *gateway* in front of your website, *backed by PayPal.*

visual.title: *SARA*
visual.pill: 💳 Backed by PayPal · by Sartech Labs

scenes.vo: Every agent comes through it. The gateway shows your rules, takes a small refundable deposit through PayPal, and checks every single request. Your site doesn't change.
scenes.caption: Every agent comes *through it.* The gateway shows your *rules,* / takes a small *refundable deposit* through PayPal, and checks *every single request.* Your site doesn't change.

scenes.chapter: // 05 — now you can tell them apart
scenes.vo: Now behaviour tells them apart. Good agents follow the rules and get every cent back. Bad agents are blocked, and lose it.
scenes.caption: Now *behaviour* tells them apart. Good agents follow the rules and get *every cent back.* / Bad agents are *blocked,* and lose it.

scenes.vo: And that flood of 39,000 requests a minute? Cut off at the rate limit, and it costs the bot its deposit.
scenes.caption: And that flood of *39,000 requests* a minute? / *Cut off* at the rate limit, and it *costs the bot* its deposit.
